provider.name: Hivenet
provider.summary: French cloud that rents GPU instances billed per second from prepaid credits. Its pricing page lists an hourly price for each instance size; the figure here is the one-GPU instance as the page shows it, in euros before tax and converted to US dollars at the day's ECB rate. It is the whole instance - 8 vCPUs, 73 GB of memory and 125 GB of disk with one GPU - not the GPU alone. Larger sizes cost the same per GPU.
provider.notes: Rendered pricing page (cells served as "-", filled by a script from the presets API, which picks one preset per name across locations - france-2 for the RTX 5090); data-price="<n>x-<GPU>" spans, vCPU rows skipped, only the 1 x row read (larger sizes same rate per GPU); scope instance (8 vCPU, 73 GB RAM, 125 GB disk included); on_demand, per_gpu, region null; EUR before tax ("Applicable taxes may still be added")
